mechanism: Both agents cause CNS depression; carisoprodol metabolizes to meprobamate (CNS depressant) and fentanyl is a potent opioid, resulting in additive respiratory depression, sedation, and overdose risk.
action: Avoid combination if possible; if necessary, use lowest effective doses with careful monitoring of respiratory function, consciousness level, and consider alternative analgesics; patient education on overdose risk and naloxone availability essential.
